# Beauty Sleep Studio PDX

> Portland lash extension, lash lift, and brow lamination studio in Nob Hill (Northwest Portland). Licensed esthetician Haley specializes in extensions, lifts, and brows — book online or call.

Location: 1308 NW 20th Ave, Suite 4, Portland, OR 97209. Nob Hill / Northwest Portland — Overton Center (blue house, NW 20th & NW Overton). Phone: 928-499-1270 (call or text). Email: beautysleepstudiopdx@gmail.com.

Hours (confirm in booking — Saturday is every other week): Monday–Wednesday 10:00am–6:00pm; every other Saturday 10:00am–5:00pm; Thursday, Friday, and Sunday closed.

Services and pricing (matches the website): Classic Lash Extensions full set $180 — fills $80 (60 min) / $100 (90 min); Hybrid Lash Extensions full set $200 — fills $90 (60 min) / $110 (90 min); Volume Lash Extensions full set $250 — fills $100 (60 min) / $120 (90 min); Lash Removal $40; Lash Lift + Tint $110; Lash Lift Only $95; Lash Tint Only $40; Brow Lamination $95; Brow Lamination + Tint $110.
